sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Commercial CGI Visual Effects and 3D Character Animation

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law with Common-Law commercial overlay

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 23 of 2015 on Money Laundering and Financial Crimes, as amended; Law 129 of 2020 establishing the Ultimate Beneficial Owner Registry; Decree No. 363 of 2015 implementing LEY 23-2015; Ley 32 de 1927 (Sociedad Anonima formation); Codigo de Comercio de Panama, Titles I and III.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Director and Officer Consent to Act

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Registered Agent and Beneficial Owner
Registered Agent or Property Owner in Panama

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory PEP and sanctions screening must be performed prior to onboarding and on an ongoing basis against the United Nations Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT Sanctions List, and Panama's domestic sanctions and judicial orders issued under Law 23 of 2015. The compliance file must verify identity, UBO lineage, source of funds, and business purpose; files must be maintained for at least five years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Publico de Panama - eRegistro Online Corporate Name Reservation Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Official corporate names must be expressed using the Latin or Spanish script; foreign-language words may be used only as part of a distinctive element and must be transliterated into Latin characters; the name must contain or be immediately followed by the expression 'Sociedad Anonima' or the abbreviation 'S.A.'.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within five business days of an adverse name decision, the applicant may file a written memorial with the Direccion General de Registro Publico attaching the original name-search certificate and explaining the distinctive character of the requested name. If the rejection is sustained, an administrative appeal may be lodged with the higher administrative authority of the Registro Publico; final recourse lies with the Sala Tercera (Administrative Chamber) of the Supreme Court of Justice of Panama. A new name reservation may be filed at any time after the rejection notice is issued.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Qualified permissibility: a Sociedad Anonima must maintain a physical registered office in Panama through a licensed resident agent. A pure virtual mailbox or remote-only address is not sufficient for the legal seat and service of process. The licensed agent's address may serve as the registered office, but the company's statutory books, corporate records and minutes must be available at that location or otherwise accessible for inspection by Panamanian authorities.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to moderate. For a low-risk 3D animation/VFX production holding entity, the probability of an unannounced on-site inspection in the first 12 months is estimated at 8-12%. The risk rises to approximately 25% if the company opens a Panama banking account, receives funds from foreign subsidiaries, or becomes subject to AML/CFT audit triggers.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate name search and reservation fee
Charter filing and incorporation registration fee
Notarial authentication of Articles of Incorporation
Licensed registered agent service - first year
Registered office and domiciliation fee - first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Resident Agent or office provider
Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Panama / notary
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff plus agent handling fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Independent legal opinion and due diligence memorandum

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: General Corporation Law of 1927 (Ley 32 de 1927), as amended by Ley 4 de 2010 and Ley 40 de 2010; see Articles 1-20 on formation, Articles 62-65 on capital and shares, and Articles 70-75 on directors and officers.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Public Registry of Panama (Registro Público de Panamá), Mercantile Section (Sección Mercantil).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Public deed of incorporation (Escritura Pública de Constitución de Sociedad Anónima) containing the Pacto Social y Estatutos.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account rule; the Articles typically state an authorized capital of USD 10,000 split into registered shares, but paid-up capital may be zero or a nominal amount as agreed by the incorporator. Shares may be issued fully paid without any escrow mandate.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 1 – SPECIAL MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS. The undersigned Directors adopt the following resolutions: 1) The subscription of 100 ordinary shares of no par value by the founding shareholder is approved, with the subscribed capital declared as paid-in in accordance with the statutes; 2) The corporation adopts its registered office at [Street Address], Panama City, Province of Panama, as its legal domicile; 3) [Full Name] is appointed President, [Full Name] Secretary, and [Full Name] Treasurer, each to serve one fiscal year; 4) The President is authorized to negotiate leases, open bank accounts, and file all public registrations. All voting for the resolutions is unanimous. DATED this [date].

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Registry of Panama – Online Reservation Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the proposed corporate name (e.g., 'PA_CORP, S.A.') through the Public Registry's online token reservation system or via a licenced attorney. Pay the fixed pre-reservation fee (approximately USD 5) and obtain a reservation certificate valid for 30 days. Verify the name does not conflict with existing Panamanian companies.
required_dossiers: Valid passport or ID of the applicant
Power of Attorney for the licenced attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected due to conflict, file a reconsideration request or immediately reserve an alternative name; resubmit within the original reservation window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Panamanian Notary Public (Notaría Pública de Panamá)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a Panamanian attorney to draft the Pacto Social y Estatutos, including corporate purpose, registered address, share capital, director designations, and officer provisions. The incorporators must appear before a notary, acknowledge their signatures, and have the deed certified as a public instrument.
required_dossiers: Power of Attorney (if executed through counsel)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary identifies drafting errors, issue a notarial correction (suspend the deed) and recertify; no re-notarization from scratch is required unless a fundamental provision is void.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of Fiscal Stamp Tax and Registry Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Banco Nacional de Panamá / General Directorate of Revenue Collection Window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Calculate the stamp tax (0.10% of authorized capital) and the standard incorporation registry fee (approximately USD 250). Make payment using a certified check, bank draft, or electronic transfer to the Public Registry's official collection account. Obtain the stamped official receipt ('póliza' or 'timbres') as evidence of fee settlement.
required_dossiers: Fee calculation memorandum signed by counsel
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any underpayment appears, the Registry will issue a deficiency notice; the applicant must pay the difference plus a statutory surcharge and resubmit the payment receipt.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing and Inscription with the Mercantile Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Registry of Panama – Mercantile Section (Sección Mercantil)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the notarized deed, fee receipts, and supporting documents to the Registry's front desk or submit electronically through the authorized e-filing portal. The Registrar (Registrador) reviews legal compliance with Law 32 of 1927. Upon approval, the corporation is assigned an inscription number and the documents are published in the Registry's official index.
required_dossiers: Power of Attorney and attorney identity card (carné)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry issues a 'repliegue' (deficiency notice), the attorney must satisfy the noted defects within 10 working days; if rejected, a reconsideration appeal can be lodged with the Public Registry's Director General.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Corporate Certificate and Certified Inscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Registry of Panama – Mercantile Section
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the inscription is recorded, request a certified copy of the corporate existence (Personería Jurídica) and the certificate of incorporation. This authenticated document serves as conclusive evidence of the Sociedad Anónima's legal existence and permits subsequent tax registration and license applications.
required_dossiers: Official fee payment for certified copies
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains typographical errors, submit a written request for correction to the Mercantile Section; judicial rectification is available for substantive mistakes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Operating License (Aviso de Operación) Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipality of Panama – Commercial Licenses Directorate (Dirección de Licencias Comerciales)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: As the corporation is engaged in service-based 3D animation and visual effects, apply for a municipal 'Aviso de Operación' (commercial operating notice). File the corporate certificate, lease agreement for the operating office, and any professional registration forms. Pay the annual municipal fee and display the license at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Lease agreement or ownership title of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality rejects the application for incomplete documentation, submit the missing lease or RUC documents within 5 working days; an administrative appeal may be filed with the Municipal Council if the rejection is unjustified.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – no industrial licensing board for CGI/animation services; only the Municipality of Panama's Commercial Licenses Directorate has jurisdiction for general office operations.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal Aviso de Operación (commercial operating notice) – service-based office license, not an industrial permit.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment of Panama (Ministerio de Ambiente, MiAMBIENTE).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – service-only office activity not listed as requiring an Environmental Impact Assessment (Category I) under Decree No. 32 of 2011.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for pure digital production; must comply with municipal sewage and solid waste handling standards; no volumetric wastewater or VOC emission thresholds triggered in a 3D animation workspace.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Panama Fire Department (Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá); structural load approval and building compliance from the Municipality's Engineering Directorate for the leased office; workplace occupational registration with the Ministry of Labor (MITRADEL) for employees.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas, Panama; online portal eTax 2.0 via https://etax.dgi.gob.pa
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entity must apply for a Panama Tax ID (RUC) through an appointed resident agent, submitting articles of incorporation, public registry certificate, identity documents of directors and beneficial owners, and evidence of registered office; DGI issues RUC after proving residence of the agent and opening a fiscal file; for non-resident electronic service suppliers, simplified registration via eTax may be allowed when a Panama business establishment is created.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Territorial_Scope; Panamanian corporations are taxed only on Panama-source income; foreign-source active business income is outside the net income tax base; entity itself remains a separate taxpayer and not eligible for a United States-style check-the-box pass-through election.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No general check-the-box election exists; taxpayers may elect optional consolidated filing regime upon approval for groups with common ownership; may elect to be treated as a small taxpayer (Pequeño Contribuyente) under the simplified ITBMS regime if annual turnover does not exceed the legal threshold; holding companies may elect special tax status under applicable regimes (e.g., Multinational Headquarters) only upon separate statutory qualification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto a la Transferencia de Bienes Corporales Muebles y la Prestación de Servicios (ITBMS) – Value Added Tax
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Registro obligatorio sin umbral de ventas para toda persona que realice actividades gravadas; no obstante, existe régimen simplificado para pequeños contribuyentes con ventas brutas anuales hasta USD 36,000 (umbral referencial); for non-resident digital services, registration is required from the first B2C supply with Panamanian consumers.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All taxpayers are required to issue electronic invoices through the DGI authorization system (Facturación Electrónica), with pre-clearance of invoice numbering and a digital fiscal code; real-time electronic transmission to the tax authority is mandatory for taxpayers in the general regime, including B2B invoices; PDF/XML formats must include the DGI-expedited authorization number and QR code; foreign suppliers of digital services must self-declare through eTax 2.0 without local invoicing.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exported from Panama and services rendered entirely abroad or provided to non-resident clients for use/benefit outside Panama are zero-rated for ITBMS, provided the taxpayer remains a registered VAT/ITBMS taxpayer and the export is properly documented. Commercial CGI/3D animation services produced in Panama for a foreign broadcaster/platform are considered an export of services when the legal domicile of the client is outside Panama and the economic use occurs abroad, and may thus benefit from 0% VAT and input credit refunds.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Panama Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Mercancías de Exportación)
Bill of Lading / Airway Bill with consignee outside Panama (for physical deliverables)
Commercial invoice and signed international service contract
Certificate of Non-Receipt / proof of delivery or acceptance by the foreign client
Bank transfer or SWIFT advice evidencing inward payment of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Panama's tax authority may retroactively reclassify zero-rated exports as taxable supply if the exporter fails to deliver documentary proof or if the foreign-consume test is not met; penalties include a 50% surcharge on the omitted ITBMS, default interest, fines up to USD 10,000 for missing e-invoice records, and clawback of VAT refunds; repeated fraud may trigger criminal tax liability and suspension of the taxpayer's operating license.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (Banking Superintendent of Panama) acting as the banking and foreign-exchange oversight body; the Republic has no central bank in the conventional sense, and Banco Nacional de Panamá serves as the fiscal agent.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama operates a fully dollarised economy (the US dollar is the legal tender). There is no separate national currency, no exchange-control authority, and no dual-tier market. Both capital and current account transactions are freely convertible, and profit remittances require no prior exchange-reserve approval. Practical hurdles are limited to bank-level AML/KYC reporting and documentary evidence of the commercial substance of the transfer.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Because Panama uses the US dollar as legal tender, export receipts are already in the domestic currency equivalent; there is no statutory surrender timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no requirement to remit export proceeds to a designated account. Exporters retain free disposition of receipts.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BAC International Bank, Inc. (formerly BAC Panama)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. Panama does not yet provide a dedicated electronic-money-institution (EMI) licence. Foreign EMIs such as Wise, Mercury or Relay generally only onboard clients resident in their own licensed jurisdictions. A Panama S.A. may integrate Wise for outgoing B2B supplier payments only if a corresponding local or US settlement account can be opened; otherwise, inbound receipts must clear via traditional SWIFT correspondent banking or the target local partner bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance of the beneficial owner and/or authorised signor is generally required at the final onboarding interview or via a notarised power-of-attorney granted to a local representative. Remote opening is possible for the corporate onboarding steps, but a face-to-face or notarially verified identity check, plus verification of corporate existence and source of funds, is mandatory under the prevailing AML decrees (e.g. Law 23 of 2015 and its implementing regulations).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Company name or business nature suggests high-risk media activity without supporting documentation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Technical scope description, sample animation contracts, client invoices and statement of underlying 3D/VFX services, plus a letter from the company's external auditor confirming that the business operates entirely as a commercial CGI/VFX producer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual corporate structure with foreign shareholders and no physical office in Panama.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Updated corporate registry (Poder y Ficha), transfer and registry law registrations, a signed asset-holding or operational-lease agreement for a physical or virtual office, UBO declaration, passport copies and notarised good-standing certificates from the ultimate beneficial owners' jurisdictions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency international receivables from a single foreign client without clear trade rationale.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed master services agreements, statement of work subject to ISIC 5911 delivery, tax returns showing declared income, and bank reference letters confirming previous transactional history and economic activity in the entertainment production sector.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Injected equity is routed via SWIFT MT103 inward transfers from the shareholder's corporate bank account to the Panama S.A.'s USD operating account. The bank requires full beneficiary details, expected-value fields (colon 32A), and counterparty bank reference. Prior notice through the corporate online portal plus proof of the underlying equity resolution and shareholder loan or capital increase agreement is advisable. There is no exchange-control approval, but the receiving bank files a currency/AML report under its own risk-based due-diligence framework.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements to international subcontractors and licensees are executed primarily through SWIFT MT103 credits and, where needed, commercial letters of credit (MT700) for larger milestone payments. Local salaries and domestic vendor payments are cleared through the Panamanian Automated Clearing House (ACH) and the local Swift-local index. All outbound wires must be accompanied by a purpose-of-payment code and supporting purchase order or service contract to relieve the originating bank's AML screening.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Cross-currency forwards on non-USD currencies (EUR, GBP, CAD)
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in markets where a deliverable forward is not available
Foreign-currency swap and rolling swap alternatives
Currency and interest-rate structuring via the offshore SWAP Market, subject to bank counterparty credit approvals

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Franchise Tax (Impuesto Anual de Sociedades) — USD 300 standard tier for authorized capital up to USD 10,000; USD 400 tier if authorized capital exceeds USD 10,000
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI), Ministry of Economy and Finance; payment remitted through Banco Nacional de Panamá
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due in advance by 15 January of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic 10% statutory surcharge on late payment; DGI default status blocks the annual Certificado de Personería Jurídica (Good Standing Certificate) and notarial transactions; prolonged non-payment enables administrative strike-off or judicial dissolution of the corporate registration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Final Beneficial Owner (UBO) Report — Transparency Registry Declaration (Registro de Transparencia de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) — Transparency Registry unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Initial declaration within 30 days of incorporation; updated declaration within 30 days of any shareholding or control change; annual ratification on the corporate anniversary cycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory fines under Law 70 of 2019 (up to USD 5,000 per violation), suspension of public-registry certificate issuance, and legal representative liability for inaccurate filings

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración Jurada de Renta) — mandatory only for S.A.s holding an active RUC or generating Panama-source revenue
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 15 March following the close of the fiscal year (calendar-year taxpayers)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 10% of tax due plus monthly interest; tax liens and provisional assessments on repeated failure; a pure offshore S.A. with no Panama-source income and no RUC has no filing obligation but must document extraterritoriality

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Municipal Aviso de Operación (Business Operation Patent) annual renewal — applicable only if the S.A. holds a local municipal operating license in a Panamanian district
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Alcaldía Municipal of the relevant district (e.g., Municipality of Panama)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 January for active municipal licenses
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Municipal fines, interest, and closure or suspension of the local business patent; not applicable to an offshore 3D-animation production company without Panamanian premises or local activity

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit by a Panamanian certified public accountant (Contador Público Autorizado) when annual gross income or total assets exceed USD 3,000,000 (B/. 3,000,000); DGI may also request audited statements at its discretion; banks, insurers, and public-interest entities are subject to sectoral audit rules
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted for public-interest entities; IFRS for SMEs acceptable for the standard S.A.; statutory tax bookkeeping must follow Panamanian generally accepted accounting principles

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Law 70 of 2019 every Panama S.A. must keep its final beneficial ownership declaration current in the DGI Transparency Registry; any share transfer or change of control must be lodged within 30 days, and registry data must be ratified annually on the corporate anniversary through the DGI e-portal; the corporate legal representative (secretary or resident agent) remains accountable for completeness and accuracy
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Shareholders (Share Ledger with Stock Transfer Sheets)
UBO internal file and supporting identification records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 250 – USD 850 per year for resident agent (agente residente) and registered office services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500 – USD 15,000 per year if the compulsory audit threshold is crossed; not required below USD 3,000,000 gross income/assets

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% on Panamanian-source taxable income with a territorial scope; income derived from foreign sources is outside the Panamanian corporate income tax base.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday for generic commercial 3D animation production; qualifying multinational headquarters under the SEM regime and Panama Pacifico licensed operators can obtain preferential rates or 0% tax on eligible foreign-source earnings. Foreign-source VFX/rendering fees are excluded from Panama taxation when the services are performed and economically supplied abroad.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 202 (Declaración Anual de Impuesto sobre la Renta para Personas Jurídicas), submitted through the DGI electronic tax platform (dgi.mef.gob.pa); transfer-pricing annexes are filed under Form 291 when triggered.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual. Advance income-tax instalments may be required monthly or quarterly depending on the taxpayer's classification.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months after the fiscal year-end; a calendar-year Sociedad Anónima must file no later than 31 March of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross receipts derived from Panamanian-source commercial activities, including 3D animation/VFX production fees for services performed or economically exploited in Panama.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only services with a Panama-side client, Panama-based production studio, or Panama market exploitation. Foreign render-farm fees and overseas pre-production services should be classified elsewhere.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross receipts derived from foreign sources, separately identified for territorial-tax reconciliation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: List foreign-source revenue as informational only. Verify that crews, servers, direction, and contractual performance are located outside Panama; retain contracts and bank records proving the source.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible costs and expenses: salaries, freelance artist payments, software licenses, cloud-rendering costs, amortization, marketing, and administrative overhead attributable to Panama-source revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions must be directly allocable to Panama-source gross income and supported by invoices, payroll records, and wire-transfer evidence. Non-resident production companies cannot deduct expenses booked to offshore sister entities without economic substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Depreciation and amortization of animation and CGI equipment, proprietary software, and copyrights used to produce Panama-source revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Depreciation is allowed only for assets used in Panama. Assets located abroad or held by an offshore IP shell are not depreciable for Panama tax purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income (Panama-source gross income minus allocable deductions and allowable loss carryforwards).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Cannot use foreign-source losses to reduce Panama-source taxable income; loss carryforward is limited to five years.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax at 25% on net taxable income, reduced by prepayments, withheld at-source credits, and applicable treaty-credited taxes.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only tax withheld under an executed Panama DTA is creditable. Foreign income taxes paid on foreign-source profits are not creditable against Panama corporate income tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a penalty of 10% of the tax due, subject to a minimum flat fine for nil-liability returns, plus monthly default interest of 1% on unpaid tax. False or incomplete declarations are penalized by administrative fines and the criminal tax-evasion provisions of the Fiscal Code and Criminal Code.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividends distributed by a Panama S.A. to shareholders, resident or non-resident, out of taxable Panama-source profits. The withholding is borne by the paying corporation and is separate from the 25% corporate income tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim reduced dividend WHT under an applicable Panama DTA, the shareholder must be the beneficial owner and submit a current Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) issued by the foreign tax authority to the Panama S.A. before payment. The withholding agent applies the treaty rate at source or withholds the full 10% and the shareholder files a refund claim with DGI. Documentary proof of the TRC, beneficial-ownership declaration, and payment vouchers must be retained for the statutory limitation period.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory Panama source rates: interest 6% and royalties 12.5% on payments to non-residents. Treaty rates generally range from 0% to 10% for interest and 5% to 10% for royalties, subject to TRC, beneficial ownership, and anti-abuse limitations.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: PAB/USD 2,000,000 in annual controlled transactions with related parties triggers mandatory Local File documentation; a Master File and Country-by-Country Report are required for multinational groups meeting consolidated revenue thresholds under Panama's transfer-pricing implementing rules. Below the threshold, related-party transactions must still be supported by adequate functional and pricing analysis if the DGI initiates a review.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Panama's Economic Substance Regulations (Law 254 of 2021 and enabling rules) apply to entities carrying on geographically mobile relevant activities. A Panama S.A. deriving income from 3D animation/VFX production, licensing of CGI content, or related service contracts must demonstrate real management, physical premises, qualified employees, and locally incurred operating expenditures. A pure tax-optimized shell without substance will be denied territorial benefits and treated as economically present under the profit-attribution rules.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing Form 202 while intentionally reclassifying Panama-source animation/VFX revenue as foreign-source, or inflating offshore service fees to minimize the 25% corporate income tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative correction of tax, default interest at 1% monthly, surcharge of up to 50% of the omitted tax, and criminal sanctions under Panama Criminal Code and Fiscal Code including imprisonment between two and six years and a fine up to the amount of tax evaded.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and legal representatives who sign a false declaration or participate in the misclassification are jointly and severally liable for the tax, interest, and penalties. Courts may pierce the S.A. veil for abuse of legal personality, order civil restitution, freeze personal assets, and impose travel bans pending recovery.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using a Panama S.A. without real operations solely to invoice overseas 3D animation services, maintaining only nominee officers and a registered agent, or holding VFX IP in a service company with no employees, office, or decision-making in Panama.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DGI may disregard the juridical entity, re-source the revenue as Panama-source, deny the foreign-source exemption, assess the 25% corporate tax, apply a 50% fraud surcharge, and impose economic-substance penalties under Law 254 of 2021.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Corporate veil-piercing applies when the S.A. is used as an instrument of fraud. Nominee directors face civil restitution, disqualification from serving as directors in Panama, asset seizures, and criminal liability for false declarations filed with the public registry.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to prepare or file Form 291/Local File documentation, or charging non-arm's-length prices for animation services, CG asset transfers, or IP royalties between the Panama S.A. and a foreign related party.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DGI may recharacterize the cross-border transaction at arm's length, adjust taxable income, impose late interest and a penalty of up to 100% of the transfer-pricing adjustment, and assess separate fines for non-filing of documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve or execute non-compliant intercompany contracts are jointly responsible for the tax deficiency where they acted with knowledge of the underpayment. Court orders may include restitution, freezing of director accounts, and prohibition on leaving Panama until the assessed liability is secured.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining undisclosed beneficial ownership, using bearer shares or opaque offshore chains to conceal the animation studio's real owner, or accepting production payments through shell bank accounts without Clearing House KYC/AML verification.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Panama Law 23 of 2015 imposes monetary fines on legal entities and responsible officers; the Criminal Code's money-laundering provisions carry 5 to 12 years imprisonment and confiscation of assets derived from or related to the offence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers may be prosecuted personally for failing to identify the beneficial owner or for facilitating anonymous financial flows. Remedies include civil forfeiture, restitution orders, travel restrictions, and disqualification from regulated industries.
